baseline: da40a72 plus coordinator worktree changes already present
implementation: Scans local class-folder datasets by relative path and content hash without decoding images; emits deterministic class mapping, sample IDs, counts, and a root-independent dataset fingerprint.

Creates deterministic per-class train/validation/test splits and stratified no-replacement subsets with versioned SHA-256 algorithms. Impossible small-class ratios are reported as unavailable; train sampling never borrows from another split.
Insufficient sample budgets retain the requested limit, cover every available class when possible, and report uncovered classes when not.
Selected-image verification decodes only requested samples, checks content has not changed since indexing, and reports all damaged relative paths without replacement.
Explicit exclusions produce a new fingerprinted manifest and never delete source files. Content, class, and manifest changes invalidate repeat compatibility with file-level evidence.
Embedded both new Python modules in the Rust worker asset package.

validation.result: passed: 4 classification/sampling integration tests and 4 existing data adapter tests
passed: 57 worker modules, embedded asset coverage complete

limitations: This task provides the data indexing/split/sampling service foundation; it does not yet connect these manifests to the human-facing CLI workflow.
The built-in layout is local class-folder raster data. Image decoding requires Pillow; indexing and content hashing do not.
A full product-level user workflow still depends on transform, preview, preset, and CLI integration tasks.
